title: Optimal Oracle Complexity for Finite-Sum Monotone Inclusions
summary: We present an oracle-optimal method for finite-sum monotone inclusions under mean-square Lipschitz continuity. Our switching regularization method finds a point $y$ and a certificate $g\in G(y)$ with $(\mathbb{E}\|F(y)+g\|^2)^{1/2}\le\varepsilon$ using $\mathcal{O}(n+\sqrt{n}LR/\varepsilon)$ expected component evaluations and resolvent evaluations. It removes the additive $n\log n$ cost of restarting a variance-reduced solver at every regularization stage by switching to a centered stochastic proximal iteration at regularization strength $L/\sqrt{n}$.
